asked.item: per-clip credit costs for video models

verdict.reason: The AI Image-to-Video Model table lists the credit cost per video clip for each model.

steps.text: Credit cost per video clip: framepack is 55 and runway gen3 is 85.
kling v1.5 and kling v1.6 are each 210 per video clip.
luma dream machine and minimax are each 170 per video clip.
google veo2 is 835, veo3 is 1250, and veo3/fast is 400 per video clip.
google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/text-to-video and google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/image-to-video are each 35/sec at 720p and 50/sec at 1080p.
